messages:
sara: :rotating_light: runtime alert (sev2) — repeated OOM + `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` on us-west-2 workers, node pool g4-large. Seeing steady resident growth on a subset of pods starting ~20:10 UTC. Putting immediate watch on the pool.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-4832 — runtime OOM spike, notified eng-oncall. PagerDuty triggered to @sara and rotation.
mike: On it. Any quick indicators from logs? is this single model or cross-model?
alice: quick triage: appears concentrated on the long-seq chat workload (seq > 8k tokens). Runtime allocator shows slab occupancy creeping up across KV slot arenas. Not classic immediate leak — more like gradual slot retention after paging churn.
sara: logs show repeated stack traces referencing `attention_cache::slot_pin()` and `kv_page_manager::forget_free()` failing to reclaim. Also seeing `CUDA kernel illegal address` around when cudaMalloc retries happen. Sending a snippet.
sara: ```
[2024-11-16T20:13:02Z] worker-25 runtime: attention_cache: pin(slot=0x7f8b4c) -> refcount 1
[2024-11-16T20:13:03Z] worker-25 runtime: kv_page_manager: free_attempt(id=1234) -> deferred (pinned)
[2024-11-16T20:15:41Z] worker-25 cuda: cudaErrorIllegalAddress in launch at src/attn_kernel.cu:412
[2024-11-16T20:15:41Z] worker-25 runtime: OOM when allocating 256MiB
```
dan: Repro on staging with long history conversations — after ~2k requests resident set increases ~100-200MB and doesn't drop. Evict loop isn't cleaning some `prefix_kv` entries because soft refs are held by pending async ops.
mike: Actions: 1) Scale down long-seq routing to fallback smaller model variant (temp config) 2) Force rolling restart of affected pods to drain pinned refs 3) Toggle `KV_MAX_WINDOW` env to 4k to limit per-request window. I'll run 1 and 2 now.
alice: I can push a hotfix to the allocator: make `forget_free()` record deferred frees and attempt synchronous cleanup on restart. Quick patch not safe for prod longterm but ok for mitigation. Preparing PR.
oncall-bot: Apply-ops: Rolling restart scheduled for pool `rw-usw2-g4` (10 pods) at 20:30 UTC. Patch toggle command: `kubectl set env deploy/worker KV_MAX_WINDOW=4096 -n redwood` — run by oncall.
mike: Done `kubectl set env` and started rolling restart: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker -n redwood --timeout=5m` — watching pod readiness.
sara: Initial impact summary for customer ops: ~8% of requests for the chat long-history route returned 5xx over the 20:10–20:22 window, latencies spiked to 3-10s for affected customers. No PII exposures. Notifying CS for top affected accounts.
alice: PR #4267 created: quick synchronous deferred-free on restart + defensive null-check in attn kernel launch. Marked as hotpatch; will coordinate full allocator audit after incident.
dan: After restarts, nodes showed immediate drop of ~1.2GB RSS on worker-25 and cuda errors stopped. Still watching for recurrence — leaving a 30m post-incident watch.
sara: Escalation note: change routing defaults so long-history requests gradually degrade to `model-small` when worker memory margin < 15%. Ops ticket assigned to eng-runtime for allocator root cause: TASK-983.
mike: taking handoff for nightwatch. Leaving runbook steps pinned in the thread. If it reoccurs, don't restart the whole pool at once — probe one pod at a time and capture `heaptrack`/`nvprof` before restart.
oncall-bot: Handoff: @mike will be on-call until 03:00 UTC. Add any follow-ups to INC-2024-4832.
sara: :thumbsup: thanks team. Next steps: 1) full allocator audit, 2) add observability for pinned ref counts, 3) permanent fix for deferred-free race. I'll update post-mortem later.
